name: Zaleplon
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: Aldehyde oxidase is the main pathway to 5-oxo-zaleplon; CYP3A4 contributes a smaller desethylation pathway. Oxidized metabolites are glucuronidated and eliminated in urine.
